Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Data Scientist

As a Data Scientist, you will design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering, machine learning (ML), and analytics solutions that accelerate Clinical Development and advance therapies for patients.

You will act in support the Center for Design & Analysis, partnering with data scientists and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines, analytical tools, and visualization solutions. You will contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of innovative analytics capabilities, helping to optimize methods, algorithms, and processes while ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with Amgen's quality and compliance standards.

• Collaborating with research scientist and other data scientists to develop AI and advanced analytics solution to speed drug research and development.
• Designing, writing, and testing data / ML pipelines and other advanced analytic / visualization solutions
• Collect business requirements / user stories for new or enhancements to existing analytic solutions
• Train users in the use of solutions provided by the CfDA Data Science organization
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives
• Adhere to Amgen Policies, SOPs, and other controlled documents.
• Participate in the development and review of CfDA Data Sciences Policies, SOPs, and other controlled documents.
• Participate in external professional organizations, conferences and/or meetings.

Accountabilities:

Data Scientist, Senior
The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you’ll use your leadership skills and data science expertise to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll guide teammates and lead the development of algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to advise your clients as they make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

What are Trust Fund Positions?

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).
Conditions of Employment

• Pass Pre-employment Background Check and Subsequent Background Investigation for position designated.

• Complete a Probationary Period.

• Maintain a Bank Account for Direct Deposit/Electronic Transfer.

• The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply.

• Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

OVERVIEW
This position is located in Washington, DC, within the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO), Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI), under the Office of the Under Secretary for Science and Research at the Smithsonian Institution (SI).

STRI provides a global platform for research on tropical forests and marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and human well-being.

The ForestGEO program is a global network of scientists and forest research sites dedicated to advancing the long-term study of the world's forests.

The GEO-TREES initiative builds on this network to improve the accuracy and verification of global forest carbon estimates through collaboration among forest research sites worldwide. The Data Scientist supports the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO) and GEO-TREES programs as a liaison between site-based data collection and the development of analytical data products.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Data Management, Scientific Analysis, and Software Programming (50%)

• Performs data-management, computational, and bioinformatics assignments supporting research in tropical biology, ecology, and forestry.

• Develops, implements, modifies, and maintains data-processing pipelines used to process plot-based tree inventory and related ecological data and to derive estimates such as forest woody biomass density.

• Evaluates the performance of existing data-processing pipelines and recommends modifications or improvements based on data characteristics, analytical requirements, user needs, and experience working with ForestGEO and GEO-TREES site teams.

• Develops and modifies computational procedures for analysis of ForestGEO and GEO-TREES scientific data using established data-science principles, methods, and practices.

• Processes, validates, organizes, and manages tree inventory, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS), and Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) data for scientific analysis and long-term storage.

• Supports the archiving and long-term management of scientific datasets to ensure appropriate organization, documentation, accessibility, and usability.

• Develops and maintains data-management solutions and informatics workflows for data acquisition, formatting, validation, processing, analysis, use, and storage.

• Implements established data standards and contributes to the development and modification of data structures and architectures appropriate to assigned projects.

• Writes, tests, documents, troubleshoots, and maintains computer code used in data-processing and analytical workflows.

• Uses programming languages and tools such as R, Python, SQL, Git, GitHub, GIS applications, and related scientific and data-management software.

• Identifies data-quality problems, inconsistencies, missing values, formatting issues, and other anomalies and determines appropriate methods for correcting or documenting them.

• Works with researchers and other technical personnel to ensure that processed data and analyticalproducts meet established scientific and program requirements.

Requirements Gathering and Technical Support (25%)

• Works closely with researchers and program personnel to identify data-processing, analytical, software, and data-management requirements for assigned scientific projects.

• Conducts technical analyses of available methods and alternatives and recommends appropriate software tools, workflows, calculations, and analytical approaches.

• Assists researchers in translating scientific requirements into practical data-processing and

• computational solutions.

• Evaluates existing workflows and recommends modifications when established approaches do not fully address the characteristics of the data or requirements of an assigned project.

• Coordinates with site representatives concerning timelines and technical requirements for acquisition and submission of plot inventory, TLS, ALS, GNSS, and related scientific data.

• Reviews submitted data to determine whether established ForestGEO and GEO-TREES formatting, documentation, and data-quality requirements have been met.

• Works with site personnel to resolve routine and moderately complex data-submission and data-quality problems.

• Coordinates with the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and other appropriate technical staff to ensure assigned development activities follow applicable systems-development, documentation, version-control, security, and software-development practices.

• Prepares technical documentation describing data-processing workflows, code, data structures, analytical procedures, and related methods.

• Assists in testing new or modified software tools, workflows, and procedures prior to implementation.

Training and Collaboration (25%)

• Develops and provides formal and informal training to researchers, site personnel, and program partners concerning ForestGEO and GEO-TREES data systems, data-management procedures, formatting requirements, data-processing workflows, and related tools.

• Serves as a technical point of contact for tree-inventory teams and other users at assigned ForestGEO and GEO-TREES sites.

• Provides advice, training, troubleshooting assistance, and technical support concerning data collection, formatting, cleaning, validation, processing, documentation, and submission.

• Explains data standards, analytical procedures, software requirements, and data-management practices to researchers and partners with varying levels of technical expertise.

• Collaborates with scientists, data managers, programmers, and other personnel to identify and resolve data-management and processing problems.

• Participates in meetings, working groups, and collaborative activities involving ForestGEO, GEO-TREES, Smithsonian staff, and domestic and international research partners.

• Shares information concerning lessons learned, recurring data problems, workflow improvements, and effective data-management practices with program staff and partners.

Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
Education and Experience:

• Professional knowledge of and skill in applying a wide range of data-science principles, concepts, methods, and practices sufficient to perform difficult data-management, processing, computational, and analytical assignments involving ecological and forestry data.

• Knowledge of data acquisition, data cleaning, validation, transformation, integration, storage, analysis, visualization, documentation, and reproducible computational workflows.

• Knowledge of computational and data-management methods is required to develop, modify, implement, and maintain processing pipelines for tree inventory, GNSS, ALS, TLS, spatial, and related scientific datasets.

• Knowledge of programming concepts and skill in applying programming languages and analytical tools such as R, Python, SQL, Git, GitHub, and related software to manipulate, process, analyze, and manage scientific data.

• Knowledge of algorithm development, software testing, version control, debugging, documentation, deployment, and maintenance practices is required to support scientific applications and data-processing workflows.

• Knowledge of spatial-data concepts, common spatial-data formats, and GIS software is required to process and evaluate geospatial information associated with ForestGEO and GEO-TREES projects.

• Knowledge of the scientific concepts associated with ecology, tropical biology, forestry, or related environmental sciences sufficient to understand data characteristics, research requirements, analytical objectives, and the relationships among data variables.

• Knowledge to select and modify appropriate data-processing and analytical methods; identify and resolve data-quality problems; evaluate alternative computational approaches; interpret results; develop recommendations; and prepare technical documentation and analytical products.

• Skill adapting or modifying established data-science techniques and procedures to address differences in data structure, quality, collection methods, analytical requirements, or site-specific circumstances.

About the Role

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this vital mission, we are seeking an executive-level Mid-Level Data Scientist to support the National Security Branch (NSB) and executive-level priority programs.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of modernizing national security missions by designing and deploying advanced machine learning models, custom algorithms, and data workflows across complex law enforcement, intelligence, investigative, and business datasets. You will collaborate directly with government stakeholders to translate sophisticated data science discoveries into actionable, mission-critical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and design machine learning, statistical analysis, and data analysis tasks across multiple projects of varying complexity.

• Collaborate with internal and external government stakeholders to identify areas for improvement in workflows or systems.

• Design new approaches to handling, analyzing, and using large volumes of law enforcement, intelligence, investigative, and business data sets.

• Develop custom data models, algorithms, and software code to optimize data search and retrieval processes.

• Use modern tools and computer programming languages, including Python scripts, to collect, wrangle, and process data.

• Design, test, and validate the quality, integrity, and performance of data and automated data processes.

• Coordinate across functional teams to deploy predictive models and monitor operational outcomes.

• Analyze findings and present actionable, data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.

• Develop visualizations, infographics, and charts to communicate results and derived findings effectively to non-technical audiences.

Required Experience/Clearance

• 6 years of experience as a Data Scientist or equivalent data-centric role (e.g., Data Analyst, Data Engineer).

• 6 years of experience utilizing multiple programming languages and statistical packages, alongside modern dataset and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) tools.

• 6 years of experience utilizing data systems to acquire, extract, and prepare data for research, exploration, or statistical analysis.

• 6 years of experience conducting exploratory data analysis to interpret complex data trends and anomalies.

• 6 years of experience cleaning, manipulating, munging, and sub-setting large datasets for analytical workflows.

• 6 years of demonstrated experience communicating technical analysis and findings to non-technical stakeholders using summary visualizations and tables.

• Demonstrated ability to learn rapidly and operate effectively both independently and within cross-functional team environments.

• Ability to obtain and maintain the required U.S. Government Security Clearance suitable for National Security Branch (NSB) programs.

Desired Experience

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physical Sciences, or a relevant analytical discipline.

• Experience applying the latest technologies and methodologies in data mining, predictive analytics, and machine learning to correlate disparate data sets and investigative events.

• Advanced Python programming proficiency and clean code development utilizing common machine learning frameworks and data science libraries.

• Advanced SQL and database management experience, including writing complex queries, optimizing database operations, and architecting basic ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines.

• Practical experience developing, training, and tuning both supervised and unsupervised machine learning models.

• Experience designing interactive BI dashboards and presentation-ready visual analytics for senior government leaders.

• Experience using version control systems (such as Git) to manage collaborative code repositories.

Data Scientist, Client Analysis (DS-II)
About the role:
We are currently looking for a Data Scientist (DS-II) to join our Data Science, Client Analysis team to be based remotely in the USA.
In this unique role as Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience developing algorithms and analyzing massive data sets to tell compelling data stories while also working in partnership with the go-to-market team to drive revenue generation for Socure by ensuring that potential and existing customers can understand - through deep analysis - the benefit and value of Socure's products throughout the pre and post sales cycle.
This is an excellent opportunity for a Data Scientist who thrives when theyre able to communicate a data story to an audience (tech and non-tech), and who is not satisfied only working behind the scenes. Data Scientists on the Client Analysis team are compensated for their part in driving new business with a generous incentive bonus opportunity on top of competitive base salary.
Responsibilities:
• Analyze massive customer data sets, come up with actionable insights, and explain how our models perform and how we can help our customers build optimal risk management policies

• Act as a Data Science advocate: deeply understand Socure's solutions (products, models and algorithms) and customers' risk challenges to educate and influence from a scientific perspective

• Create convincing data stories to showcase how we can help our customers eliminate identity fraud, streamline their end-user experience, and support their risk management efforts holistically

• Provide thought leadership and be the customer's voice for building the next generation of Socure's core models and product

• Create tools and automated workflows to improve the speed, accuracy, and reproducibility of our analysis

• Partner closely with GTM teams (Sales, Solution Consultants, Account Managers and Technical Account Managers) to derive creative ways of analysis and identify opportunities for upsell and product optimization

• Build ML models when it is advantageous to explore different approaches over the established models in production

Qualifications:
• You have a degree in a quantitative field, or equivalent work experience - advanced degree is preferred.

• You have 2+ years experience in data science, data analysis, or analytics engineering

• You have extensive theoretical and practical understanding of state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods

• You know how to write clean, performant code in Python, and have 2+ years experience working with massive real-life datasets

• You have experience querying relational databases with SQL

• You have experience working with cloud tools and technologies in AWS, Azure, Databricks, or GCP

• You know how to tell compelling stories with data (dashboarding, building interactive data stories and actionable presentations)

• You are able to explain very complex algorithms such as ML/AI models, and analyses to non-technical audiences

• You are an excellent verbal and written communicator and are comfortable delivering presentations with clear, complete messages

• You thrive in a remote startup work environment and are excellent at setting clear goals and holding yourself accountable

• You have experience in identity verification and fraud prevention (strongly preferred)

Technologies we use
The Data Science Client analysis team works across customer data, fraud and identity analytics, model evaluation optimizing workflows, monitoring/alerts, reporting and more. An ideal candidate will have experience with several of the technologies below and be excited to learn the rest.
• Python ecosystem: PySpark, Pandas, NumPy, H2O, SHAP, Seaborn, Jupyter, and related data-science libraries

• SQL and data warehouses: SQL, Redshift, Snowflake, and S3

• Data processing: Databricks, Apache Spark, Apache Arrow, and Amazon EMR

• Data pipelines and automation: Airflow, batch processing, SFTP/PGP, webhook data, and automated daily/weekly reporting

• Model evaluation and risk analytics: backtesting, train/holdout/OOT analysis, performance monitoring, threshold tuning, and model/rule QA

• Visualization and storytelling: Tableau, Looker, dashboards, and interactive presentations

• ML/AI workflows: supervised and unsupervised learning, transformers, clustering, graph analytics, explainability, and LLM/agentic workflows

• Engineering and analytical practices: Git-based version control, production-quality and reproducible analysis, automated data-quality and validation testing, API integrations, and working with structured data formats such as JSON.
